categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Juhua Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical industry focusing on fluorochemical products, chlor-alkali chemicals, coal chemical products, petrochemical materials, and food packaging materials. The company’s core business includes production and sales of fluorochemical raw materials, refrigerants, fluoropolymer materials, fluorine fine chemicals, food packaging materials, petrochemical materials, and basic chemical products. It also engages in research and development, technical services, and import-export trade.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced fluorochemical manufacturing technologies including production of first to fourth generation fluororefrigerants (CFCs, HCFCs, HFCs, HFOs), fluoropolymer synthesis (PTFE, PVDF, FEP, FKM, PFA, ETFE), and fine fluorine chemical synthesis. It emphasizes innovation in green and low-carbon refrigerants, resource recycling, and digital transformation with a focus on smart manufacturing and environmental protection technologies. The company has a comprehensive R&D system with national technology centers and numerous patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Juhua serves a broad range of industries including defense, aerospace, electronics, environmental protection, new energy, electrical appliances, chemical, machinery, instrumentation, construction, textiles, metal surface treatment, pharmaceuticals, food, and metallurgy. Its fluorochemical products are critical for strategic emerging industries such as semiconductors, new energy, and advanced manufacturing. The company’s refrigerants are widely used in household and commercial air conditioning, refrigeration, automotive air conditioning, and industrial cooling.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are based in Quzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, with additional production bases in Ningbo and overseas facilities including subsidiaries in Hong Kong and the United Arab Emirates. It has established a global operational layout for fluororefrigerants centered on Quzhou with three additional bases, and exports products internationally, with export revenue of approximately $388 million in 2023.
categories.supply_chain_position: Juhua operates across the upstream to downstream spectrum of the fluorochemical industry, including raw material procurement (e.g., fluorite, hydrogen fluoride), intermediate chemical production (chlorides, refrigerants), and downstream high-value fluoropolymer and fine chemical products. It maintains a vertically integrated supply chain with self-sufficient production of key raw materials and intermediates, supporting its fluorochemical and chlor-alkali product lines.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include high-end fluorochemical materials manufacturing, green and low-carbon refrigerant development, digital transformation, and industrial chain integration. It focuses on innovation in advanced fluorine materials, new generation refrigerants, fluoropolymer and fine chemicals, and energy-saving and environmental technologies. R&D investment increased to over 1 billion RMB in 2023, supporting 138 projects and emphasizing proprietary technology and patent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including fluorochemical raw materials, refrigerants, fluoropolymers, fine chemicals, food packaging materials, and petrochemical products. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally. The company also earns income from technical services, licensing, and investment returns from subsidiaries and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Juhua is a domestic leader and global frontrunner in fluorochemical products, especially in fluororefrigerants where it holds the largest production quotas in China and a leading global market position. It is the top domestic producer of fluoropolymers and chlor-alkali new materials like PVDC. The company faces competition from international fluorochemical giants but maintains competitive advantages through scale, technology, integrated supply chain, and innovation capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Juhua reported operating revenue of approximately 20.66 billion RMB, a slight decrease of 3.88% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 943.5 million RMB, down 60.37%. Total assets reached 23.38 billion RMB, with net assets of 16.07 billion RMB. The company has maintained a steady growth trajectory over recent years despite market challenges, with continuous investment in R&D and fixed assets totaling over 23 billion RMB in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Juhua emphasizes its comprehensive and integrated fluorochemical industry chain, advanced proprietary technologies, and strong innovation capabilities as key differentiators. Its products offer superior performance, environmental compliance (low ODP and GWP refrigerants), and are critical to strategic emerging industries. The company’s scale, quality control, brand reputation, and commitment to green and digital transformation provide competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets.
